name: salesforce
title: Salesforce
description: Communicate with Salesforce using Java DTOs.
label: cloud,saas

properties.name: operationName
properties.label: common
properties.description: The operation to use

properties.name: topicName
properties.label: consumer,producer
properties.description: The name of the topic/channel to use

properties.name: apexMethod
properties.description: HTTP verb used for the Apex REST invocation, such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE. Applies to the apexCall operation and defaults to GET. Can be overridden per message with the CamelSalesforceApexMethod header.

properties.name: apexQueryParams
properties.description: Query params for APEX method

properties.name: apiVersion
properties.description: Salesforce API version.

properties.name: backoffIncrement
properties.description: Backoff interval increment for Streaming connection restart attempts for failures beyond CometD auto-reconnect.

properties.name: batchId
properties.description: Identifies a batch within a Bulk API v1 job. Required by getBatch, getRequest, getResults, getQueryResultIds and getQueryResult unless a BatchInfo message body supplies it. Not used by Bulk API 2.0.

properties.name: contentType
properties.description: Bulk API content type, one of XML, CSV, ZIP_XML, ZIP_CSV

properties.name: defaultReplayId
properties.description: Default replayId setting if no value is found in initialReplayIdMap

properties.name: fallBackReplayId
properties.description: ReplayId to fall back to after an Invalid Replay Id response

properties.name: format
properties.description: Payload format to use for Salesforce API calls, either JSON or XML, defaults to JSON. As of Camel 3.12, this option only applies to the Raw operation.

properties.name: httpClient
properties.description: Custom Jetty Http Client to use to connect to Salesforce.

properties.name: includeDetails
properties.description: Include details in Salesforce1 Analytics report, defaults to false.

properties.name: initialReplayIdMap
properties.description: Replay IDs to start from per channel name.

properties.name: instanceId
properties.description: Salesforce1 Analytics report execution instance ID

properties.name: jobId
properties.description: Identifies the Bulk API job to act on, for Bulk API v1 operations such as getJob, closeJob, abortJob, createBatch and getResults, and for the bulk2 operations that target an existing job. Operations that accept a JobInfo or BatchInfo message body can take the id from there instead.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Limit on number of returned records. Applicable to some of the API, check the Salesforce documentation.

properties.name: locator
properties.description: Locator provided by salesforce Bulk 2.0 API for use in getting results for a Query job.

properties.name: maxBackoff
properties.description: Maximum backoff interval for Streaming connection restart attempts for failures beyond CometD auto-reconnect.

properties.name: maxRecords
properties.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve per set of results for a Bulk 2.0 Query. The request is still subject to the size limits. If you are working with a very large number of query results, you may experience a timeout before receiving all the data from Salesforce. To prevent a timeout, specify the maximum number of records your client is expecting to receive in the maxRecords parameter. This splits the results into smaller sets with this value as the maximum size.

properties.name: notFoundBehaviour
properties.description: Sets the behaviour of 404 not found status received from Salesforce API. Should the body be set to NULL NotFoundBehaviour#NULL or should a exception be signaled on the exchange NotFoundBehaviour#EXCEPTION - the default.

properties.name: notifyForFields
properties.description: Notify for fields, options are ALL, REFERENCED, SELECT, WHERE

properties.name: notifyForOperationCreate
properties.description: Notify for create operation, defaults to false (API version >= 29.0)

properties.name: notifyForOperationDelete
properties.description: Notify for delete operation, defaults to false (API version >= 29.0)

properties.name: notifyForOperations
properties.description: Notify for operations, options are ALL, CREATE, EXTENDED, UPDATE (API version < 29.0)

properties.name: notifyForOperationUndelete
properties.description: Notify for un-delete operation, defaults to false (API version >= 29.0)

properties.name: notifyForOperationUpdate
properties.description: Notify for update operation, defaults to false (API version >= 29.0)

properties.name: objectMapper
properties.description: Custom Jackson ObjectMapper to use when serializing/deserializing Salesforce objects.

properties.name: pkChunking
properties.description: Use PK Chunking. Only for use in original Bulk API. Bulk 2.0 API performs PK chunking automatically, if necessary.

properties.name: pkChunkingChunkSize
properties.description: Chunk size for use with PK Chunking. If unspecified, salesforce default is 100,000. Maximum size is 250,000.

properties.name: pkChunkingParent
properties.description: Specifies the parent object when you're enabling PK chunking for queries on sharing objects. The chunks are based on the parent object's records rather than the sharing object's records. For example, when querying on AccountShare, specify Account as the parent object. PK chunking is supported for sharing objects as long as the parent object is supported.

properties.name: pkChunkingStartRow
properties.description: Specifies the 15-character or 18-character record ID to be used as the lower boundary for the first chunk. Use this parameter to specify a starting ID when restarting a job that failed between batches.

properties.name: queryLocator
properties.description: Query Locator provided by salesforce for use when a query results in more records than can be retrieved in a single call. Use this value in a subsequent call to retrieve additional records.

properties.name: rawPayload
properties.description: Use raw payload String for request and response (either JSON or XML depending on format), instead of DTOs, false by default

properties.name: reportId
properties.description: Salesforce1 Analytics report Id

properties.name: reportMetadata
properties.description: Salesforce1 Analytics report metadata for filtering

properties.name: resultId
properties.description: Identifies one result set of a completed Bulk API v1 query batch, as returned by the getQueryResultIds operation. Used only by getQueryResult, together with jobId and batchId.

properties.name: sObjectBlobFieldName
properties.description: SObject blob field name

properties.name: sObjectClass
properties.description: Fully qualified SObject class name, usually generated using camel-salesforce-maven-plugin

properties.name: sObjectFields
properties.description: SObject fields to retrieve

properties.name: sObjectId
properties.description: SObject ID if required by API

properties.name: sObjectIdName
properties.description: SObject external ID field name

properties.name: sObjectIdValue
properties.description: SObject external ID field value

properties.name: sObjectName
properties.description: SObject name if required or supported by API

properties.name: sObjectQuery
properties.description: Salesforce SOQL query string

properties.name: sObjectSearch
properties.description: Salesforce SOSL search string

properties.name: streamQueryResult
properties.description: If true, streams SOQL query result and transparently handles subsequent requests if there are multiple pages. Otherwise, results are returned one page at a time.

properties.name: updateTopic
properties.description: Whether to update an existing Push Topic when using the Streaming API, defaults to false

properties.name: fallbackToLatestReplayId
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Whether the pub/sub consumer needs to fallback to the latest replay id when the provided id is not valid. If set to false, the component will keep retrying; in order to treat this as an exception you can use BridgeExceptionHandlerToErrorHandler and handle the exception in the route.

properties.name: pubSubBatchSize
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Max number of events to receive in a batch from the Pub/Sub API.

properties.name: pubSubDeserializeType
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: How to deserialize events consume from the Pub/Sub API. AVRO will try a SpecificRecord subclass if found, otherwise GenericRecord.

properties.name: pubSubPojoClass
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Fully qualified class name to deserialize Pub/Sub API event to.

properties.name: pubSubReplayId
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The replayId value to use when subscribing to the Pub/Sub API.

properties.name: replayId
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The replayId value to use when subscribing to the Streaming API.

properties.name: replayPreset
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Replay preset for Pub/Sub API.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: consumerWorkerPoolEnabled
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Use thread pool for processing received Salesforce events, for example to process events in parallel.

properties.name: consumerWorkerPoolExecutorService
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To use a custom thread pool for processing received Salesforce events, for example to process events in parallel.

properties.name: consumerWorkerPoolMaxSize
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Maximum thread pool size size for consumer worker pool.

properties.name: consumerWorkerPoolSize
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Core thread pool size size for consumer worker pool.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: allOrNone
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Composite API option to indicate to rollback all records if any are not successful.

properties.name: apexUrl
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Path of the Apex REST resource to invoke, appended to /services/apexrest/ on the instance URL, for example MyApexClass/. The apexCall operation needs this value, which can be given as this option, in the endpoint path as apexCall/MyApexClass/, or in the CamelSalesforceApexUrl header. Placeholders written in curly braces are resolved from message headers of the same name.

properties.name: compositeMethod
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Composite (raw) method.

properties.name: eventName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Name of Platform Event, Change Data Capture Event, custom event, etc.

properties.name: eventSchemaFormat
properties.label: producer
properties.description: EXPANDED: Apache Avro format but doesn't strictly adhere to the record complex type. COMPACT: Apache Avro, adheres to the specification for the record complex type. This parameter is available in API version 43.0 and later.

properties.name: eventSchemaId
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The ID of the event schema.

properties.name: rawHttpHeaders
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Comma separated list of message headers to include as HTTP parameters for Raw operation.

properties.name: rawMethod
properties.label: producer
properties.description: HTTP method to use for the Raw operation

properties.name: rawPath
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The portion of the endpoint URL after the domain name. E.g., '/services/data/v52.0/sobjects/Account/'

properties.name: rawQueryParameters
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Comma separated list of message headers to include as query parameters for Raw operation. Do not url-encode values as this will be done automatically.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
